methodologyNotes: Roster of 12 widely searched active/powered nearfield studio monitors, entry-level through prosumer. Every priceUsd, releaseDate and headline spec was independently re-verified in June 2026 against manufacturer product pages (krkmusic.com, us.adam-audio.com, presonus.com, mackie.com, kaliaudio.com) and major US retailers (sweetwater.com, guitarcenter.com, bhphotovideo.com). priceUsd is the published US per-unit price for the exact config named ('each' or 'pair' as noted); where a model is normally listed as a pair, the per-unit price is the pair price divided by two and flagged. Power figures follow each manufacturer's own published convention for the unit as sold (e.g. PreSonus prints '100W (50W/side)' on its single-unit page). Frequency-response strings carry the manufacturer dB qualifier where published. All 12 confirmed active (powered); Mackie CR5-X is a multimedia/reference monitor sold as a studio monitor. No fabricated models found; nothing removed. accessedAt 2026-06-20.

products.name: KRK Rokit 5 G4
products.provenance: Re-verified: 5 in woofer, 1 in tweeter, 55 W, 43 Hz–40 kHz and balanced TRS/XLR combo input confirmed on the KRK Rokit 5 G4 product page. Price $169.99 confirmed on the KRK G4 collection page. Release 2019 (NAMM 2018 intro / 2019 availability).

products.name: KRK Rokit 7 G4
products.provenance: Re-verified: 7 in woofer, 145 W peak total Class-D, 42 Hz–40 kHz confirmed via KRK product page and Sound on Sound / MusicRadar reviews. Price $224.99 confirmed on KRK G4 collection page. Tweeter consistent across G4 family. Release 2019.

products.name: Yamaha HS5
products.provenance: Re-verified: 5 in woofer, 1 in dome, 70 W total (45 W LF + 25 W HF), 54 Hz–30 kHz at -10 dB, XLR + TRS balanced inputs confirmed via Yamaha specs and Sweetwater listing. Price $199.99 each confirmed on Sweetwater. Launch 2013.

products.name: Yamaha HS8
products.provenance: Re-verified: 8 in woofer, 1 in dome, 120 W total (75 W LF + 45 W HF), 38 Hz–30 kHz at -10 dB, XLR + TRS balanced confirmed via Yamaha specs and Sweetwater. Price $398.99 each confirmed on Sweetwater (pair $797.98). Same HS-series 2013 launch as HS5.

products.name: JBL 305P MkII
products.provenance: Re-verified: 5 in woofer, 1 in woven-composite neodymium dome, 82 W total (dual 41 W Class-D), 49 Hz–20 kHz ±3 dB, XLR + TRS inputs confirmed via jblpro.com and Sweetwater. Sweetwater pair lists $338.00 (= $169 each); sold individually too. Release 2018 (3 Series MkII, announced ahead of NAMM 2018). Source URL switched from FrontEndAudio to the JBL Pro manufacturer page (verified).

products.name: JBL 306P MkII
products.provenance: Re-verified: 6.5 in long-throw woofer, 1 in neodymium dome, 112 W total (56 W each Class-D), 47 Hz–20 kHz ±3 dB (39 Hz–24 kHz at -10 dB), XLR + TRS inputs confirmed via jblpro.com and Sweetwater. Price $199 each confirmed on Sweetwater single-unit listing. Release 2018, same 3 Series MkII launch. Source URL switched from FrontEndAudio to JBL Pro page (verified).

products.name: PreSonus Eris E3.5

specs.inputs: TRS balanced, RCA unbalanced, 1/8 in aux (front)

products.provenance: Re-verified: 3.5 in woven-composite woofer, 1 in silk dome, 50 W total Class-AB (25 W/side), 80 Hz–20 kHz, TRS + RCA + front 1/8 in inputs confirmed on PreSonus 2nd-Gen page and Sweetwater. Price $114.99/pair confirmed on both. Original E3.5 released 2017.

products.name: PreSonus Eris E5 BT

specs.inputs: TRS balanced, RCA unbalanced, Bluetooth 5.0, 1/8 in aux (front)

products.provenance: Re-verified: 5.25 in woven-composite woofer, 1 in ultra-low-mass silk dome, '100W (50W/side) Class D' as printed on the PreSonus single-unit product page, TRS + RCA + Bluetooth 5.0 + front 1/8 in aux + sub out, no XLR. Price $164.99 each confirmed on PreSonus.com. Frequency response 53 Hz–22 kHz. Released 2022 (Sound on Sound launch coverage). Note: power_w 100 reflects PreSonus's own published per-unit spec wording (system 50 W/side).

products.name: Adam Audio T5V
products.provenance: Re-verified directly on the Adam Audio US shop page: 5 in polypropylene woofer, 1.9 in U-ART accelerated-ribbon tweeter (HPS waveguide), 70 W total (50 W LF + 20 W HF Class-D), 45 Hz–25 kHz at -6 dB, XLR + RCA inputs, sold each, price $239.99. Release 2018 (T-Series manual dated March 2018).

products.name: Adam Audio T7V
products.provenance: Re-verified directly on the Adam Audio US shop page: 7 in polypropylene woofer, 1.9 in U-ART ribbon tweeter, 70 W total (50 W LF + 20 W HF Class-D), 39 Hz–25 kHz at -6 dB, XLR + RCA inputs, sold each. Manufacturer page price confirmed $289.99 (a third-party search quoting $249.99 was a stale/different listing and was rejected). Release 2018, same T-Series launch as T5V.

products.name: Mackie CR5-X

specs.inputs: TRS balanced/unbalanced, RCA unbalanced, 1/8 in aux

products.provenance: Re-verified: 5 in polypropylene-coated woofer, 0.75 in ferrofluid-cooled silk dome, 80 W Class-D, TRS/RCA/1/8 in inputs, no XLR confirmed on Mackie CR-X blog and B&H listing. Price $199.99/pair (one powered + one passive cabinet) confirmed via Mackie and major retailers. Release March 2020. Frequency response 50 Hz–20 kHz is the consistently published retailer figure (not re-stated on the Mackie blog) — retained as widely corroborated.

products.name: Kali Audio LP-6 V2

specs.inputs: XLR balanced, TRS balanced, RCA unbalanced

products.provenance: Re-verified: 6.5 in paper woofer, 1 in textile dome, 80 W total (40 W LF + 40 W HF Class-D), 47 Hz–21 kHz at ±3 dB (39 Hz–25 kHz at -10 dB), 115 dB max SPL, XLR + TRS + RCA inputs, sold each. Price $249 each confirmed on Kali Audio and Sweetwater. Release: LP Series 2nd Wave available mid-October 2021 (units made after 1 May 2021 are 2nd Wave) per Gearnews.
